summary: Using `{{ }}` inside a conditional expression is now a syntax error; reference the variable directly in the expression.
questions: Why do I get 'Template delimiters are not supported in expressions'?
Should I use {{ }} in when or assert conditions?
How do I use a variable inside an assert expression?

answer_card.title: Don't use {{ }} inside conditionals
answer_card.answer_md:
Conditionals are already expressions, so templating a variable inside them fails:

```yaml
- assert:
    that: 1 + {{ value }} == 2
```

Error: `Syntax error in expression. Template delimiters are not supported in expressions: expected token ':', got '}'`

Reference the variable directly:

```yaml
- assert:
    that: 1 + value == 2
  vars:
    value: 1
```
